IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: PROVIDES CHILD DEVELOPMENT SERVICES TO CHILDREN OF LOW INCOME FAMILIES.
IRS990.MissionDesc: EES' MISSION IS TO PROVIDE A UNIQUE AND AFFORDABLE CHILD DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM DESIGNED TO MEET THE SOCIAL, EMOTIONAL, PHYSICAL, AND EDUCATIONAL NEEDS OF THE INDIVIDUAL CHILD, AS WE STRENGTHEN AND PRESERVE THE FAMILY AND ALL WHO INFLUENCE THE LIFE OF THE CHILD.
IRS990.Desc: EES OFFERS FULL DAY AND PART DAY PRESCHOOL FOR CHILDREN OF LOW-INCOME WORKING FAMILIES. THESE SERVICES HELP YOUNG CHILDREN AND THEIR FAMILIES BY OFFERING HIGH QUALITY PRESCHOOL SO CHILDREN ARE WELL-PREPARED FOR KINDERGARTEN AND PARENTS CAN WORK OR FINISH THEIR EDUCATION. 1,200 STUDENTS AGES 3 TO 5 YEARS OLD ARE SERVED IN THIS PROGRAM FUNDED THROUGH THE CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION, CALIFORNIA STATE PRESCHOOL PROGRAM.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: EES OFFERS FULL DAY CHILD CARE FOR TODDLERS FROM LOW-INCOME WORKING FAMILIES. THESE SERVICES HELP YOUNG CHILDREN AND THEIR FAMILIES BY OFFERING HIGH QUALITY PRESCHOOL SO CHILDREN ARE WELL-PREPARED FOR KINDERGARTEN AND PARENTS CAN WORK OR FINISH THEIR EDUCATION. 160 STUDENTS AGE 3 MONTHS TO 3 YEARS OLD ARE SERVED IN THIS PROGRAM FUNDED THROUGH THE CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL SERVICES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: EES HAS A CONTRACT WITH SAN DIEGO COUNTY OFFICE OF EDUCATION, QUALITY PRESCHOOL INITIATIVE (QPI) FUNDED BY FIRST 5 SAN DIEGO TO PROVIDE HIGH-QUALITY PRESCHOOL OPPORTUNITIES. THE ULTIMATE GOAL OF THE QUALITY PRESCHOOL INITIATIVE IS TO REDUCE THE SCHOOL READINESS GAP AND IMPROVE SCHOOL ACHEIVEMENT IN SAN DIEGO COUNTY BY PROVIDING CHILDREN WITH THE KIND OF EARLY EDUCATION EXPERIENCES THEY NEED TO DO WELL IN SCHOOL AND BEYOND. QPI HAS INSTITUTED A 5 TIER PRESCHOOL QUALITY RATING AND IMPROVEMENT SYSTEM. ALL EES LOCATIONS SCORE A 4 OR 5 RATING THROUGH THE QPI SYSTEM.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EDUCATIONAL ENRICHMENT SYSTEMS (EES) IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL AND CALIFORNIA INCOME TAXES UNDER SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE (IRC) AND SECTION 23701(D) OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE. EES HAD NO UNRECOGNIZED TAX BENEFITS OR LIABILITIES AS OF JUNE 30, 2024 AND 2023. EES FILES AN EXEMPT ORGANIZATION RETURN IN THE UNITED STATES FEDERAL JURISDICTION AND WITH THE FRANCHISE TAX BOARD IN THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FORM 990 IS REVIEWED DURING MONTHLY BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETINGS, AND THE TAX AUDIT REPRESENTATIVE MAKES THE PRESENTATION AT THIS MEETING, AS WELL AS ANSWER ANY QUESTIONS FROM THE BOARD MEMBERS, AUDIT COMMITTEE, OR KEY EMPLOYEES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EACH YEAR THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND MANAGEMENT ARE REQUIRED TO SIGN A CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY WHICH IS REVIEWED AND APPROVED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. IF ANY COVERED MEMBER DECIDES THAT HE OR SHE MAY HAVE A CONFLICT OF INTEREST, THE MEMBER WILL BE EXCUSED FROM THE MEETING WHILE THE BOARD DETERMINES IF THERE IS A CONFLICT OF INTEREST. SUCH PERSON WOULD NOT BE ALLOWED TO VOTE ON THE ITEM BEING DISCUSSED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SALARY AMOUNTS FOR OFFICERS ARE APPROVED BY THE INDEPENDENT BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND COMPARABLE DATA IS REVIEWED. THIS PROCESS IS DOCUMENTED AND WAS LAST COMPLETED ON 02/11/2022. THE ORGANIZATION HAS NO KEY EMPLOYEES FOR THE SALARY APPROVAL PROCESS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST.
